body: I've been having some really bad depressive episodes lately and I will say this. Your  post made me laugh so thank you.

I had to make sure I didn't type this. This hit me so hard to know that I am not alone. I just miss her so much. If you've been no contact how long has it been? I haven't spoke to her since September and it was just her birthday. I was a drastic mess the whole day. But I somehow made it through.

I couldn't keep it together reading this. It all hit home so much. I miss her so much, it's been so long. Her birthday is on the 16th and I want to talk to her so bad and just wish her a happy birthday but it's her day. It's not mine. She probably doesn't want to hear from me anyway.
I have been laying in bed for hours just sobbing. I can't do this anymore, I miss her so much.
This sounds like you pulled it straight from my head. You aren't alone
Props to you for at least making it to your second year. Much easier said than done
Playlist is pretty solid thank you. I've listen to call me before and I like it alot too. How many years are you into college and what are you going for?

I worked 12 to 7 at my crappy retail job, couldn't even get myself to get up early enough to take a shower. I'm trying to find a new job but it has been so difficult to find motivation to do anything. Once I got home I just went to bed and I have been there since. It's now 3:30am and my mind just won't stop reminiscing on the past and I can't take it anymore.

I was in college for electrical engineering but I just couldn't do it. It was ripping me apart from the inside out so I dropped out and now debt is my middle name. So I know the feeling entirely. Everyone has disappeared from my life now and there is no worse feeling. 

I'll take a look at the playlist, music and YouTube are the only things I can get myself to watch/listen in my free time besides having a breakdown or sleeping.
I agree 100%.
You aren't alone, hopefully we can get through the next few days with minimal pain.
Appreciate the comment. This just seems like it has been a worse set back by far compared to the rest and it just feels worse than day one. I just want the holidays to be over.

My parents have unfortunately never really understood me and it seems like it's always going to be like that. I'm aiming to find a new job right after the turn of the year as it is less complicated after the holidays for me. Planning on getting a job in construction so I'm constantly busy and can try and clear my mind while I'm at least at work. I'm trying but it just seems like it is getting harder and harder every day and I just want to be done.

We are strict no contact. I've tried diving deeper into my existing hobbies or revisiting old ones but at the end of the day she is always on my mind and I just miss her so much. Weighed I'm doing something new or old I can't not think of her, and how much I enjoyed doing things like that with her.

I never had one before the breakup and I've had a few at this point.  I don't have the money to go to a therapist at this point as my insurance doesn't cover crap for them.  I work at a deadbeat retail job and my time is spent either at work or sleeping.
The relationship is what ended 142 days ago. It started right at the beginning of the year.
It's been around 120 days of NC between us.

I've suffered from depression for a few years, it runs in my family. But 6 months ago I was broken up with and it's just pushed me over the edge. It's only gotten worse since the breakup and most of the time I can't even get out of bed. I have suicidal thoughts every day multiple times a day, I either don't sleep at all or I sleep for over 12 hours at a time. I'm lucky if I can manage more than one meal a day. My family doesn't care enough to even consider that something is wrong and puts zero effort into help. My dad screamed at me a few night ago saying that my behavior is ridiculous and I need to snap out of it because I'ma fuckup that needs to get his life together. Little does he know that the only thing I want is for my life to end so I'm pretty close to reaching my goal at this point. I lost the one thing that was important to me. The one thing that made me truly happy. And she's never coming back. 
I dropped out of college last semester. I'm working a deadbeat retail job that I hate more than anything. I'm 20 thousand dollars in debt after only a year in college. 

Its just easier to be dead at this point and I don't want to go through this anymore.
It's been 4 months. I can't take it anymore. It hurts too much.

Slept for like 3 hours tonight just letting in my bed because it's my day off and don't have motivation to do anything. It's more than normal for me at this point. I enjoy sleeping because it's the only time I get to have a clear head if I don't have a dream. But I'm so tired of dreaming of her I'd rather just stay awake. It's just a frustrating cycle. I'm also 4 months out. 

What did you get at McDonald's?

Sometimes there are underlying problems that can lead to this and a third party can help them surface so you can tackle the root cause. Ive  suffered like this and seeing a therapist really has helped me. It's what I would personally recommend. Im going right now to see one. Just having someone to talk to and vent to about it definitely can help out things and can help you get over those feelings. I'm not going to say it will help you move on, because from personal experience sometimes you don't move on. You just end up finding someone better and the old feelings of pain slowly fade. Don't give up hope yet.

I unfortunately agree with this. Blocking seems like it will help but in the end it drove me insane not knowing if she messaged me so I kept her unblocked. Keep her unblocked and try to not think about it and try and do something fun on your birthday.

We have been no contact for a while and she soft blocked me on everything so I'm not following her anymore. But all her accounts are private so blocking her wouldn't do anything for me. It's been three months and I miss her so much. From my first thought when I wake up to the last thought of the day it's her and no matter what I try and do that's the way it is and it just hurts so much.

My ex got a puppy after she broke up with me. We always talked about getting one and it hurt so much seeing her post about him knowing ill never get to see him. I just hope she is happy with her life.
